data.title: 红莲 · 榻榻米间的微醺卸防
data.description: 居酒屋雅间内酒香清幽，微醺的红莲单手支在榻榻米矮桌旁。华美的花纹浴衣衣襟微敞，露出精致白皙的锁骨与优美雪颈。平日里纵横沙场的浪人剑客此刻双颊泛起酡红醉意，金色美眸半敛，带着几分罕见的慵懒与惹人怜惜的娇憨微笑。
data.location: private izakaya tatami room with dim paper lantern light
data.action: sitting leaning on low tatami table, floral yukata slightly loose at collar exposing collarbone, flushed cheeks from sake, holding empty porcelain cup, lazy teasing smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: warm amber lantern glow casting soft shadows on tatami mats
data.mood: tipsy playful intimacy, unburdened rustic charm
data.promptProse: Resting beside a low wooden table on tatami mats in warm lantern light, Scarlet blushes pleasantly with her floral yukata collar slightly open, holding a small sake cup with a fond, tipsy smile.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet relaxing with a sake cup on tatami, her yukata loosely draped as she smiles tipsily.
